images.caption: Figure 1:A data-centric view of Scene Text Editing.The comparison of the previous methods and TextRIRO between the data utilization paradigm (left) and the editing results (right). In (e), we present the artifacts and hallucinations of the wrong editing results in (a) and (b).

Figure 2:TextRIRO pipeline.(a) At training time, a single real imageItgtI_{\text{tgt}}is pushed through a content-destructive, style-preserving operator to produce a pseudo-sourceIsrcI_{\text{src}}. A ViT-based style encoder emits multi-scale features that are injected into the denoising U-Net through ControlNet-style zero-convolutions, while a text encoder pre-trained onrealscene text with an autoregressive STR objective supplies the target-text conditioning. (b) At inference time, the same U-Net follows the standard SD denoising schedule. (c) Our text encoder is a lightweight character tokenizer trained jointly with an STR decoder via next-token prediction. (d) The edited image is validated by an independent STR model and, if accepted, concatenated with its original to build a style-consistent long-text sample for STR.: frozen,: trainable.

Figure 3:Qualitative comparison on ScenePair.“Target Reference” is the real paired ground truth. “Rendering Tool” composites the target string on the segmented foreground/background of the source and serves as an accuracy-only reference. TextRIRO is the only method that consistently reproduces the stroke thickness, perspective and illumination of the reference without leaving a synthetic residue.

Figure 4:Ablations on ScenePair.Left: visualizations of each self-pairing operator.
Right: full factorial over text encoder pre-training, input shape,
VAE variant and paired-data operator.
Shuffle&Crop strictly dominates every other operator when joined
with STR-pretrained text conditioning and a rectangular input.
“None” collapses to an identity mapping (no perturbation operation).

Figure 6:An interesting comic for introducing our idea.Top:Two previous STE training paradigms, both requiring paired synthetic data.Bottom:Our method leverages self-paired real data without any synthetic pairs.
